Hi Noor, regarding SLOTPLAN-118: The design review decision was that a dropped occurrence still uses up one of the `count` occurrences (similar to an excluded date in a calendar series). So the result can be shorter than `count`; the series is not extended to make up for it. Hope that helps!

Hi! Yes, the design review agreed that in 'nearest' mode, a value exactly halfway between two grid points goes to the earlier point. So align_to_grid(645, 30) == 630 and align_to_grid(615, 30) == 600. Hope that helps!
